Luis Hernandez.description: conversing about Luis Hernandez discussing with Denise Brooks the progress and community benefits of a local-hire agreement for a datacenter project, with Denise offering support to promote community involvement. @ <persona> Denise Brooks
chat: Luis Hernandez

Hey Denise, how's it going? I see you're busy helping customers. I'm just on my way to the job site and thought I'd stop by to see how things are going. By the way, I'm still working on getting that local-hire agreement for the datacenter project. How's business been for you lately?
Denise Brooks

Hi Luis! Business has been steady, especially with all the talk about the datacenter. I'm really hoping the project brings more foot traffic to the area. It's great to hear you're pushing for the local-hire agreement; that's important for our community. Are you feeling optimistic about it?
Luis Hernandez

I'm cautiously optimistic, Denise. It's been a bit of a process, but I think we're making progress. I just want to make sure that our community benefits from this project, you know? Thanks for your support. I'll keep you updated on how it goes.
Denise Brooks

Absolutely, Luis. It's crucial that our community gets a fair share of the benefits. If there's anything I can do, like spreading the word or gathering support, let me know. I really appreciate your efforts on this.
Luis Hernandez

Thanks, Denise. I might take you up on that offer if we need more community support. It's always good to know we have local businesses like yours backing us. I'll drop by again soon to keep you posted. Have a great day!
